subject: https://github.com/the-omega-institute/trureturing
summary: A sign-filling puzzle, four lifts and two incidence counts explain why a 75-line contextual geometry has degree twelve but meets every classical hexagon in fifteen lines.
summary_zh: 从正负号游戏、四种提升和两次关联计数，解释为什么 75 线情境性几何度数为 12，而每个经典六边形的交集为 15。
title: Why twelve is not fifteen
